messages:
alex_finance: Heads-up — AcmeHealth flagged invoice 78921 (private deployment) asking for a prorated platform fee credit + retroactive support-tier upgrade. They claim the migration window impacted capacity and they were billed full month. cc: @ryan-sales

sara_cs: They sent the signed SOW showing upgrade to Premium on Feb 1, but billing shows Standard for Feb invoice. Customer wants the Feb platform fee adjusted and the support tier true-up applied from Feb 1. They also asked for an SLA addendum due to the migration incident.

ryan_sales: I approved the Premium upgrade on Feb 1 on the sales side; looks like the billing change never propagated. I can forward the signed SOW and the acceptance email thread. We should avoid a full refund ask — propose a one-time correction + SLA addendum. @lina_contracts can you confirm what we need?

lina_contracts: We have the SOW in Salesforce but no amendment executed for billing change. Legal can accept the sales email trail as evidence, but finance needs to decide credit amount. For SLA addendum we need a short form signed by the customer (1 page).

ben_engineering: Quick note from infra: migration outage window per logs was 2026-02-14 03:05–10:22 UTC (about 7.3 hrs). No extended downtime recorded. If they claim broader impact, ask for precise timestamps.

alex_finance: Invoice snippet for reference:
```
Invoice 78921 (Feb cycle)
- Platform fee (monthly): $15,000
- Support (Standard): $3,000
- True-up usage: $4,200
- Late fee: $250
Total: $22,450
```
Customer asks: prorated platform fee credit for migration window and retroactive upgrade (Standard -> Premium) credit for Feb.

maya_finance: Proposed approach: 1) Calculate prorated platform fee credit for outage window if we accept the 7.3 hrs claim: prorate = $15,000 * (7.3 / 720) ≈ $152. 2) Support tier difference (Premium - Standard) = $7,000 - $3,000 = $4,000 monthly; prorate for the remainder of Feb (if effective Feb 1 it's full month) — but sales says upgrade effective Feb 1 so we should bill Premium moving forward and credit the $4,000 difference for Feb only. 3) Waive the $250 late fee as goodwill. That totals ≈ $4,152. I'll round to $4,150 for a cleaner credit. Approvals needed for credits > $5k; so this stays under exec threshold.

jen_support: Customer is asking for SLA addendum that includes a 99.9% availability clause for the private deployment and a clause for single-digit-hour incident response. We can draft the addendum template once legal confirms.

alex_finance: Two questions: 1) Can legal accept sales email + SOW as sufficient for retroactive support tier change for Feb? 2) Approve one-time credit $4,150 (prorated platform + support diff + waive late fee) to be applied to invoice 78921.

lina_contracts: Legal ok to accept the sales thread + SOW as evidentiary for this kind of billing correction. We'll still require the customer to sign the SLA addendum going forward. Draft and send the addendum; apply credit contingent on signed addendum within 30 days.

paul_finance: I approve the $4,150 one-time credit and waiving the late fee, contingent on: (a) sales uploads the SOW + acceptance thread to the billing ticket; (b) contracts sends the SLA addendum to the customer with 30-day signature window; (c) note in ledger: "one-time credit - migration goodwill & retroactive tier correction". Alex, please process credit and update invoice notes.

billing_bot: Invoice 78921 status: PAID (payment id: pay_0A7X9). Applying credit will generate a refund/credit memo. Manual review required before issuing refund.

alex_finance: Will do. I'll open a billing ticket, attach the SOW/email thread, create credit memo for $4,150, and mark it pending until SLA addendum signed. I'll also add a note to the customer's account to prevent duplicate credit. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sara_cs: I'll coordinate the SLA addendum with the customer and ping when signed. Thanks team!
